name: Print
description: This app allows you to print PDFs to printers on your local network.
author: thooton

changes.text: Nothing hard-codes the installed id, so a copy under another id installs beside the original.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Use common keypad and sizing helpers in existing UI consumers.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
One bad PDF no longer spoils the rest, and a dozen screens say what they should.
Menu forgets printers, edits Recent, sorts files, acts on jobs.
Menu does nothing, rather than repeat the screen's buttons.
Menu opens Options, Back goes back.
Reach printers on a Wi-Fi without internet, and find Brother printers.
